text: Membership in the sovereign local agent runtime class turns on four testable properties: user-controlled execution, user-held state, heterogeneous composition, and machine-to-machine settlement.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

isBasedOn.name: Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes

abstract: Membership in the class defended here turns on four properties, each of which can be checked against a running system rather than against a description of one.
